disposition_reason: Kombucha, SCOBY and tea Pb concentrations and ceramic container Pb migration are printed in Tables 2 and 3.

study.design: Outbreak investigation of family lead poisoning with analysis of kombucha, raw materials and ceramic containers Lead-poisoning outbreak case report (kombucha brewed in a lead-glazed ceramic vessel); not representative of commercial kombucha.
study.origin: Ibiza, Balearic Islands, Spain (home and small factory)
study.market: Local venues in Ibiza supplied by the factory
study.method: ICP-MS (Agilent 7900) after microwave digestion (solids) or 5% nitric acid (kombucha); migration into 4% acetic acid, 24 h, 22 C
study.lod_text: Quantification limit <0.02 mg/L (water, sugar); migration <0.02 mg/L
study.qa: Internal standard Ir; four-point external calibration

controls.control: Container material: ceramic fermentation vessels versus glass SCOBY vessels, acetic acid migration test
controls.outcome: Pb in 4% acetic acid after 24 h: glass <0.02 mg/L in both; ceramic fermentation vessels <0.02 mg/L in 4 of 6, 0.15 and 0.41 mg/L in two

controls.control: Ceramic marketing (sale) containers versus ceramic fermentation vessels, same supplier glaze
controls.outcome: Pb migration 5.8-73 mg/L (approximate) from marketing containers versus <0.02-0.41 mg/L from fermentation vessels
Factory kombucha Pb 0.95 mg/kg (14 days) -> 7.1 mg/kg approx. (19 days); home kombucha 2.9 mg/kg (40 days) -> 5.8 mg/kg approx. (60 days); packaged in ceramic marketing container 47 mg/kg approx.

controls.control: Raw materials (water, sugar, tea) ruled out as source
controls.outcome: Water <1.0 ug/L, sugar <0.020 mg/kg, tea leaves 0.048-0.23 mg/kg versus kombucha 0.95-47 mg/kg

regulatory_or_exposure.what: Ceramic ware Pb migration limit for containers over 3 L (category 3), Spain RD 891/2006
EFSA BMDL values used in risk assessment (developmental neurotoxicity 0.5, cardiovascular 1.5, nephrotoxicity 0.63 ug/kg bw)
No Spanish or EU maximum level for Pb in kombucha

Water results (<1.0 ug/L well, mains and bottled water) are water, not findings; not recorded.
